tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /gu ru'i thugs sgrub snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs/ /
༄༅/ /gu ru'i thugs sgrub snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// gu ru'i thugs sgrub snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs//

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas chos kyi sku /longs spyod rdzogs sku 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// rgyal kun 'dus zhal padma 'byung gnas la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// bde chen mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mkhar chen bza'// zab gter bka' babs brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// bka' drin sum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// yi dam kun 'dus rta phag yab yum dang*// rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro ma mgon gter srung sogs// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// srid bde 'khrul pa'i rang mtshang kun rig ste// thun mong thun mong ma yin lam zhugs nas// smin byed dbang gis rgyud smin grol byed kyi// rim gnyis rnal 'byor mtha' ru phyin par shog /dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen mtha' dag ma tshang med 'byor te// don gnyis lhun grub padma thod phreng gi /go 'phang dka' ba med par myur thob shog /
ces pa'ang padma dgyes pas so//

1$0000250༈ gu ru zhi ba'i thugs sgrub snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i las byang dngos grub gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300gu ru zhi ba'i thugs sgrub snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i las byang dngos grub gter mdzod ces bya ba/ ma hā gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo// 1$0000250rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'dus zhal mchog /bgrang yas dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rnam rol du// 'char ba'i khyab bdag padma thod phreng rtsal// rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo der btud nas// gang gi thugs sgrub kun gyi mthar thug pa// zab lam snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu yi// las byang 'jug bde'i khrigs su 'dir bsdebs kyi// byin rlabs mchog gi bka' drin stsol bar mdzod// 1$0000300

de la 'dir snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i las byang khrigs chags su bkod pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po la yang yo byad bsham pa dang*/ cho ga dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkram/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod gtor spyan gzigs yo byad la sogs pa mtha' dag tshogs par byas la/ gnyis pa cho ga dngos la bdun gyi dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/
bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad badzra sa mā dzaḥ
sa sad pa'i spyan sngar/
na mo: phyogs dus bde gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas la: bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus kun: deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar: sgo gsum gus pas rtag tu skyabs su mchi:
lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/
ho: deng nas bzung ste 'khor ba ma stongs bar: rgyal ba rnams kyi phrin las dbang bsgyur te: mtha' med 'gro kun myang 'das gzhir 'god pa'i: sems ni byang chub dam par bskyed bgyi 'o:
lan gsum/ gsum pa tshogs gsag pa ni/

bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol: sgo gsum dwangs bas rab tu phyag 'tshal zhing: zag med kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod: mi dge'i lam zhugs sdig sgrib nongs pas bshags: dus gsum rgyal ba'i mdzad par rjes yi rangs: bla med chos 'khor bskor zhing bzhugs gsol 'debs: bdag gzhan dge tshogs byang chub mchog tu bsngo: 'khor ba yongs dag chos dbyings thob par shog:
lan gsum gyis tshogs bsags shing rgyud dag par byas nas/
dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥtshogs zhing rnams rang la bstim/
bzhi pa bgegs skrad pa ni/
rang nyid skad cig gis dpa' bo rta mgrin yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur
par bsams la/ bgegs gtor
raṃ yaṃ khaṃ
gis bsreg gtor sbyang*/
oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrī: gnod byed bgegs kun tshim byed pa'i: zag med 'dod yon bdud rtsir gyur:
'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor zhing*/
phaiṃ:
zhes brjod pas gtor mgron spyan drang*/
sthā na pa ti kshe tra pā lañtsa na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā:
zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/

hūm̐: srid gsum gnas pa'i log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: 'dir 'dus longs spyod gtor mas tshims byos la: bde bar dengs shig bka' las 'da' byed na: khro rgyal 'bar bas rdul du brlag par 'gyur: bhū mi pa ti sarba ba liṃ ta khā hi: oṃ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐: gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐: gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho: bha ga bān bidyā rā dza ya hūm̐ phaṭa:
zhes bzla zhing rol mo'i sbyor ba drag po dang bcas bgegs bskrad/ lnga pa srung 'khor ni/

phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje srung ba'i 'khor lo chen pos bar mtshams med par kun tu dkrigs par gyur/ hūm̐: bdag nyid 'gyur med gdod nas rdo rje'i sku: phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje gri gug dang: ral gri rgya gram 'khor lo'i ra ba gur: khro chung mtshon cha'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: bskal pa'i me chen drag 'tshubs rab 'bar ba'iḥ gzhom med srung ba'i gur khang chen por gyur: badzra ratna padma karma tsakra rakṣa tiṣṭha hūm̐:
zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ drug pa byin dbab pa ni/

hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni rnga yab gling: padma 'od kyi gzhal yas su: rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas la: padma thod phreng rtsal du grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī dzñā na ā be sha ya a āḥ
zhes byin dbab/ bdun pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/
oṃ swa bhā ba shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddho3 haṃ
gis yongs su dag par byas la/

stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams gzhi dang rgyan dang dbyibs dang bkod pa tshad med pas/ mngon par 'phags pa'i phyogs kun tu rin po che dang padma la sogs pa'i snod phun sum tshogs par hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ 'dod yon lnga/ rin po che sna bdun/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad/ rdo rje'i lha mo bcu drug mchog gi ma da na dang*/ ru dhi ra sna tshogs pa'i bza' bca' ldag myong la sogs pa zag pa med pa'i 'dod yon gyi rnam pa thams cad/ mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams su lhun gyis grub pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā rakta ind+ra me da ghri taṃ pañtsa māṃ sa āḥhūm̐: āoṃ gu hya pū dza āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā rakta a mṛta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ.ā:
zhes pa rnams lan gsum dang*/

oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsal stong zung 'jug 'bru gsum 'phro 'du las: sna tshogs mchod sprin kun bzang rnam 'phrul pa: rab 'byams snang stong lha rnams dgyes byed rdzas: chos kyi dbyings kun yongs su gang bar gyur: oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ:
gis mkha' khyab tu spel lo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdun gyi dang po lha bskyed pa ni/

hūm̐: chos rnams mi dmigs spros bral las: kun khyab brtse ba'i snying rje bsgom: stong nyid snying rje dbyer med hrī: snod bcud 'od gsal 'khor lo'i dbus: padma nyi zla ti ra'i steng: rgyu yig hrīḥdamar 'phro 'du las: bdag nyid dbang chen he ru ka: dmar po gri gug thod pa 'dzin: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum stabs kyis bzhugs: rdo rje phag mo yum dang sbyor: dbu gtsug rta zhal phag gdong mtshan: dur khrod rol pa'i chas rnams rdzogs: ye shes me phung klong na bzhugs: spyi gtsug pad sdong nyi zla'i steng: rje btsun padma thod phreng rtsal: a tsar gzhon nu dkar dmar zhal: gsang phod snam sbyar zab ber dang: mnyen zhu sgro dar rgyan can gsol: rdo rje thod pa kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin: skyil krung rol stabs tshul du bzhugs: rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: sprin phung gtibs pa lta bur gsal:
zhes gsal gdab la/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/

hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī sarba e hye hi badzra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho:
zhes spyan drangs la/ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/

hrī: rin chen pho brang nyams re dga': dur khrod gzhal yas byin re che: padma 'dab bzhi mdangs re gsal: rtog med ro gdan bag re dro: nyi zla brtsegs pa 'od re gsal: bzhugs pa'i gnas su dang re spro: gu ru yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgyes shing byin gyis rlob phyir bzhugs: mos pa'i bu la zhal bstan 'tshal: gsung gi gdams pa'i gnad bsgrag 'tshal: thugs kyi dgongs pa'i sgo dbye 'tshal: 'gro ba'i don du sku bzhugs 'tshal: gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan:
zhes pas dgyes shing gnyis su med par bzhugs par bsam mo/ bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/

e ma ho: skye 'gag 'gyur med phrin las rdzogs: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams sgrol: yid bzhin dngos grub char 'beb pa'i: thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo: spros bral bde chen kun bzang mo: rdo rje sman gcig mtsho rgyal yum: bde stong gnyis med thabs shes sbyor: yab yum gnyis med phyag 'tshal lo: bya byed yid chos rnam par dag: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dul: dbang chen rta mchog yab yum la: gnyis med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: snang ba yab la stong pa yum: mkha' 'gro ging la phyag 'tshal lo: thams cad chos kyi dbyings su rol: chos srung tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tī tstsha ho:
zhes phyag bya'o/ lnga pa mchod pa la spyi dang bye brag gnyis kyi dang po la yang phyi nang gsang gsum las phyi mchod ni/

hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: lha rdzas phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas sil snyan yid 'ong rnams: spyan shangs thugs ka sku lus dang: zhal dang snyan du mchod pa 'bul: gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī puṣpe: dhu pe: ā lo ke: gandhe: nai bi dya: shabda pū dza ho:
nang mchod ni/

hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: rang byung nang mchod 'bul ba ni: dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog mchod: gsur chen bdug spos dri yis mchod: zhun chen snang gsal mar mes mchod: rdo rje dri chu byugs pas mchod: bdud rtsi dri chen zhal zas mchod: rkang gling thod pa'i rnga sgras mchod: dug gsum sku gsung thugs su mchod: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru mchod: snang srid phyag rgya bzhi ru mchod: gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī ma hā pañtsa pū dza ho:
gsang mchod ni/

hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: gnyis med gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: yab yum gnyis med mkha' gsang las: byang sems dkar dmar bde ba'i mchog: bde ba'i ro snyoms mchod par 'bul: sku lus rgyas phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī bo dhi tsitta ga ṇa gu hya pū dza ho:
gnyis pa bye brag tu mchod pa las/ sman mchod ni/

oṃ: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la: dug lnga sel phyir ye shes lnga rdzogs rdzas: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi:
zhes dang gzhan yang*/

kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas chos kyi sku /longs spyod rdzogs sku 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// rgyal kun 'dus zhal padma 'byung gnas la// sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ bde chen mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mkhar chen bza'// zab gter bka' babs brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// bka' drin sum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la// sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ yi dam kun 'dus rta phag yab yum dang*// rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro ma mgon gter srung sogs// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs la// sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/
rakta'i mchod pa ni/

ā: 'dod chags rnam dag padma rakta 'di: rgyud drug kun sgrol khams gsum dbang du sdud: bde mchog bde spyod rakta'i mchod pa 'di: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī ma hā rakta khā hi:
gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/

hrī: rdo rje'i snod yangs chos kyi dbyings chen por: snang srid dpal gyi gtor mas yongs su gang: longs spyod rdzas kyi mchod pa chen po 'dis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam skong gyur cig: gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi:
zhes phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyis yang dag par mchod do// drug pa bstod pa ni/

hūm̐ hrī: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje: pad stong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku ni mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i sku: gsung ni mi 'gag mnyam nyid rig pa'i gsung: thugs ni mi g.yo smra bsam brjod las 'das: sku gsung thugs ldan padma rgyal la bstod: 'gro ba'i don du rang byung 'od dpag med: bkra shis yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i sku: 'jig rten mnga' bsgyur padma rgyal po'i sras: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: rgyas pa'i las mdzad ratna thod phreng rtsal: dbang gi las mdzad padma thod phreng rtsal: drag po'i las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal: thams cad lhun grub buddha thod phreng rtsal: phrin las rdzogs pa'i rje la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: snang ba ma 'gag thugs rje chen po'i sku: rta mgrin dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye med rnam dag chos dbyings dag pa'i klong: rdo rje phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i mkha' dbyings las: thugs rje ma 'gag cir yang ston cing sprul: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam can srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:
ces bstod/ bdun pa 'dzab bzla ba ni/
gu ru'i gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum: 'od 'phros rang gi gnas gsum thim: sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs dbang bzhi thob: bde chen ye shes thob par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐:
zhes rtse gcig tu bzla ba ste/ phyi sgrub bsnyen pa'i yan lag go /

slar yang bla ma snying khar byon: longs sku gsang 'dus rdo rje 'chang: mthing gsal rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: gsang yum mtsho rgyal dkar mos 'khyud: gnyis ka gcer bu rin chen dang: rus pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes: skyil krung 'od lnga'i klong na bzhugs: thugs srog gsang sngags phreng ba las: 'od 'phros snang srid snod bcud kun: lha sngags ye shes rol par sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ ā:
zhes rtse gcig tu bzla ba ste nang sgrub sgrub pa'i man ngag go /
snying kha'i bla ma 'od du zhu: rang dang dbyer med gcig tu gyur: dkar ser dmar ljang 'od zer gyis: phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par gyur: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsitta hrīṃ hrīṃ dza dza:

zhes bzla ba ste las sbyor gyi man ngag go /bzlas pa'i mthar mchod cing bstod nas dngos grub blang*/ gsum pa rjes kyi las rim la bdun gyi dang po tshogs mchod la bshams shing byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dam rdzas su 'os pa'i tshogs kyi yo byad rnams la bdud rtsis bsang gtor byas la/
oṃ sarba dra byaṃ bi sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa:
zhes spyir bsang*/

hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros pas ma dag pa'i dngos 'dzin thams cad bsregs gtor sbyangs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las tshogs gzhong padma 'bar bar tshogs rdzas rigs lnga yab yum gyi dam tshig chen po'i rang bzhin 'dod yon gyi rnam pa cir yang 'char bar gyur/ hūm̐: chos dbyings bhañdzar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: bza' bca' btung sogs mi zad gter chen steng: nyi steng kha ṭwāṃ yi ge 'bru gsum gyi: 'od kyis rtsi bcud ye shes bdud rtsir bkug: gnyis med gcig 'dres zag med bdud rtsi'i mchog: rgyal ba dgyes byed chos dbyings yongs gang gyur: ga ṇa tsakra dzñā na a mṛta oṃ aḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī:
byin gyis brlabs la/ tshogs zhing rnams cang te'u'i sgra dang snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul pas mkha' khyab kyi 'khor lor sad par byas la/

hūm̐: bzhengs shig rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas: mi mngon dbyings nas sku skyod la: 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: sgrub rdzas rnams la byin gyis rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī e hye hi pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ: sa ma ya st+waṃ:
zhes pas spyan drangs la/ nyer spyod dang 'dod yon lngas spyir mchod nas tshogs phud rim pa gsum du spros la/ dang po mchod pa ni/

ho: rab 'byams rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rmad byung phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: zag med 'dod yon longs spyod dam tshig rdzas: bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: oṃ de ba ga ṇa sarba ga ṇa tsakra a mṛta pū dza khā hi:
bar pa bshags pa ni/
ho: lhag pa'i lha khyod bdag la dgongs su gsol: bdag cag rmongs pas rtsa ba yan lag gi: dam tshig nyams dang sdig pa'i las bgyis kun: mthol zhing bshags so byang zhing dag par mdzod:
ces dang*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum sogs brjod/ tha ma bsgral ba ni/ dmigs bya'i rū pa bcas la/

nṛ tri badzra aṅku sha dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las spros pa'i pho nya rnams kyis dmigs bya dbang med du bkug ste gzir zhing tshar bcad nas rnam shes bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor sbyar bar gyur/ hūm̐: snang srid gdod nas chos sku'i rol pa la: nga bdag 'dzin pa'i nyon mongs dgra bgegs rnams: rang rtsal ye shes rol pa'i mtshon cha yis: skye med chos dbyings dag pa'i dbyings su bsgral: mā ra ya rbad:
ces mtshon chas dum bur bcad pa'i snyigs ma'i sha khrag gi longs spyod rnams rdo rje bza' ba'i dam tshig tu spyad pas lha tshogs thams cad tshims par mos la/

ho: bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ru dra bsgral pa yi: gti mug sha chen nga rgyal rus pa dang: 'dod chags khrag sogs 'khrul rtog ma lus pa: kun bzang yangs pa chen po'i klong du bstab: māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti a mṛta khā hi:
zhes 'bul/ bsgral tha ni/
lha tshogs thams cad rang rang gi phyag rgya dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i sbyor bas dga' ba bzhi'i ros tshims par gyur/
de nas las kyi rdo rjes 'khor lo 'dus pa'i gtso bo la phyag byas/ thabs shes kyi rdzas rnams snod so sor thogs pa lag gnyis phan tshun bsnol bzhin par stob cing*/
ho: chos dbyings bhañdzar snang srid bdud rtsir bskyil: rdo rje'i bcud ldan mi zad longs spyod dang: dza gad gar mchod sgeg mdzes rdzas mchog 'bul: lhun grub bde chen klong rol dpa' bo che:
zhes brjod cing drang*/ slob dpon gyis padma'i bskor ba sngon du 'gro bas rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/
e ma ho: 'dod yon ma spang zag bral thabs shes rdzas: yid bzhin gter mdzod gu hya'i longs spyod rnams: bdag lus 'dzin bral rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: bde chen ro gcig ngang du blangs te rol:
zhes pas len/ 'dus pa gzhan rnams la'ang brim zhing lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs rnams yang dag par bsam zhing bza' ba 'khor lo'i gtso mo dang*/ btung ba 'khor lo'i gtso bos thog mar longs spyod/
gdod nas lhun grub sgo gsum dkyil 'khor 'dir: mi zad longs spyod bde chen klong rol mthus: tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs chos dbyings brjod bral klong: 'gro kun ye dag ye rdzogs rtogs par shog:
ces smon lam gdab/ de nas lhag ma bsdu/ phud cung zad bsres la las kyi rdo rjes lhag gtor byin gyis brlab par gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis dam tshig gi kha phru gdab la/
oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lhag ma'i dam tshig 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes pas nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ e ā ralli hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥ
bshug pa'i sgra drag pos spyan drang*/ me tog la sogs pas mchod nas/

hūm̐: lhag la dbang ba dregs pa'i tshogs: gtum chen drag po'i sde dpung bcas: 'dir byon sha khrag lhag gtor bzhes: dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa srungs: dgra bgegs zhing bcu cham la phob: bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: oṃ utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣa sī swā hā:
zhes rol mo dang bcas pas gtor ma phyi rol du dor ro// gnyis pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/

hūm̐: gling gi gling mchog rnga yab gling: zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas mchog nas: rig 'dzin gtso bo padma 'byung: rtsa gsum mang po'i 'khor dang bcas: bzhengs shig 'bar ba'i klong nas bzhengs: bskul lo thugs dam gnad nas bskul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs shig: gdod nas bde gshegs snying po la: bde sdug mtshan mar 'dzin pa yi: glo bur 'khrul rtog dgra bgegs dpung: rang rtsal ye shes chen pos zlog: gzhan yang phyi nang bar chad bgegs: bdud dgra rmis ltas mtshan ngan rnams: chos dbyings ye shes rig pa'i klong: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod:
ces dang*/ gsum pa chad tho bsgrag pa ni/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsir spel la/

hūm̐: srid gsum zhing 'khod dam can dregs pa'i tshogs: 'dod yon zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma longs: bde gshegs rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas dran mdzod la: mdo sngags bshad sgrub bstan pa srung ba dang*/ de 'dzin skyong zhing log 'dren dbyings su sgrol: khams gsum 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel ba dang: gang gsol phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod:
bzhi pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/

bhyo: padma'i bka' nyan bstan skyong ma dang sring: ging lang 'bum phrag bka' nyan bcas pa rnams: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas dpal gyi gtor ma longs: mtha' dmag bsrung zhing rgyal bstan ma lus skyongs: bcol pa'i phrin las thams cad sgrub par mdzod: sarba ḍā ki nī ba liṃ ta khā hi:
zhes dbul zhing phrin las gsol la/
gatstsha gatstsha swā bhā ba nāṃ:
zhes pas rang gnas su btang*/ lnga pa bro brdung ni/ gtor gzhong ri rab tu gsal ba'i 'og tu dam sri mnan par bsams la/

e: mdun du gnam lcags khang sgrom zur gsum pa: gting dog kha khyer mtho zhing dug gsum 'khrigs: las byed pho nya'i bshan ra chen po'i nang: zhing bcu'i log 'dren thams cad rab tu mnan: steng du khro rgyal pho brang ri rab btab: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rta bro brdung: byang chub mchog sems ma bskyed de srid du: mnan pa yin gyis ldang bar ma byed cig: oṃ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: stambha ya nan: mā ra ya nan:
zhes gtor mnan bya/ drug pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba la/ mchod cing bstod nas dzap kyis thugs dam bskul ba sngon du 'gro bas/

bde mchog bde spyod nam mkha'i dkyil yangs nas: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sras bcas thugs dam can: badzra gu ru padma thod phreng gi: sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor dngos grub mchog: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal: bum pa bzang po dpag bsam nor bu'i tshul: da lta nyid du bdag la bstsal du gsol: 'gyur med sku yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: 'gag med gsung gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: 'khrul med thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: yon tan re skong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: phrin las 'gro 'dul dngos grub bstsal du gsol: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: 'dzad med nor gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: thun mong yid bzhin dngos grub bstsal du gsol: bla med mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol:
rtsa sngags mthar/
kā ya wā ka tsitta siddhi pha la ho:

zhes gtor ma'i ye shes pa bdag la bstim/ dam tshig pa 'dod yon bdud rtsir zhu bar bsams la gtor zan dngos grub kyi rdzas su rol lo// sa bcad bdun pa'i khongs nas bstan pa'i las rim la/ dang po ni slar yang mchod cing bstod nas yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas pa'i mthar/
ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa// de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs//
zhes bzod par gsol/ gnyis pa ni/ dbang don gyi dkyil 'khor sogs dang 'brel na ni/
oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/
/zhes sogs kyis ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/

a: skye 'gag gnas gsum mtha' bral don gyi lhar: gshegs bzhugs dngos po'i mtshan mas dben mod kyang: 'on kyang rang gsal ma 'gag snang stong gzhi: skye med thugs srog hūm̐ gi nā dar bsdu: snod bcud kyi dngos po thams cad gzhal yas khang lha dang bcas pa la thim/ de yang rim bzhin thugs srog hūm̐ yig la bsdu/ hūm̐ gyen rdzogs thig ler yal ba'i ngang du mi dmigs par gyur/ slar yang dran rig ma hā gu ru'i skur langs
la spyod lam la 'jug go /gsum pa dge ba bsngo ba ni/

dbyer med gcig 'dus rdo rje'i mched lcam gyis: rmad byung dmigs bcas dmigs med dge bgyis mthus: khams gsum sems can bde zhing skyid pa dang: zag bcas yul snang rdo rje'i skur byang nas: 'pho med chos kyi dbyings mchog thob par shog:
ces smon lam rgya cher gdab bo// bzhi pa shis pa brjod pa ni/

oṃḥ byin rlabs mchog stsol rigs brgya'i bdag: bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog: dngos grub char 'beb zhi dang khro: yi dam lha tshogs bkra shis shog: thogs med phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog: gang la bsam pa'i don kun 'grub: dge legs mchog gi bkra shis shog:

ces shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis lam yangs par bya'o// de ltar gu ru'i thugs sgrub snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i las byang nag 'gros su bkod pa 'di yang rtsa ba'i gzhung gi dgongs pa gzhir bzung*/ kha 'gengs par 'os pa rnams gter kha 'og ma'i bla ma gsang 'dus kyi las byang snying po don gsal dang rig 'dzin las byang padma'i dgongs rgyan rnams las blangs te padma dgyes pas bris pa'o// //
